noun_definition: web refers to the online platform where users can send and manage money requests, including the ability to send scanned images as part of the transaction process.
User B refers to the account holder who is expected to view a scan request for money that has been replaced while it is still in progress.

Scan request money refers to a monetary request that is initiated by sending a scanned image and can be viewed by the recipient, in this case, User B, even if the image is replaced while the request is still in progress.
It refers to the scan request money that User B is unable to view after User A replaces the scanned image while the request is still in progress.
